summary: Refined system architecture by integrating probabilistic data structures for telemetry and optimizing parsing logic via the Chomsky Hierarchy. These efforts established a robust framework for resource-aware execution and proactive structural validation, with all development tracked against the 1% architectural output metric.
key_learnings: Layering probabilistic filters (Bloom filters, HMMs) before deterministic logic optimizes throughput.
Complexity-aware guardrails are essential for managing NP-hard resource scheduling.
Matching parsing tools to language complexity (e.g., recursive descent for JSON) prevents expensive pipeline failures.
Architectural progress is best measured by focusing the 1% growth metric on structural output.
